en: Black‑and‑white view of a grand European spa town with ornate multi‑story buildings lining both sides of a narrow river or canal. A tree‑lined promenade runs along the water, busy with well‑dressed pedestrians in early 20th‑century fashion. On the right is a long colonnaded building with statues along its roofline, likely a spa colonnade. Hills with villas rise steeply behind the town. Large wall advertisements in German are visible on the left‑side façades.
